overestimate_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between one- and two-cell overestimation.

symmetric_radius_1.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between adjacent lower and higher cost cells.

symmetric_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally across one- and two-cell errors in either direction.

underestimate_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between one- and two-cell underestimation.

limitations: The estimator kernels are sensitivity models, not calibrated production error distributions.
Actual cost cells receive equal E83 comparison weight; deployment prevalence can change expected winners.
Boundary clamping accumulates impossible under/over-estimation mass at the edge cost cell.
Expected regression is the primary objective; another utility or worst-cell constraint can select a different policy.
The audit reuses compact E83 path summaries and is not new GPU evidence.
model: Sweep exact cost-classification accuracy from 0 to 1 under boundary-clamped symmetric and one-sided ordinal error kernels. Expected risk weights each actual cost and breach metric by its full E83 comparison count.
selection_objective: minimum expected positive-delay burden per comparison
